items.source: Auto-configuration for JPA and Spring ORM.
items.translation: JPA 和 Spring ORM 的自动配置。

items.source: Auto-configuration for Hibernate JPA.
Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the Hibernate properties to customize their auto-configuration prior to use by the auto-configured EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 可被希望在使用自动配置的 EntityManagerFactory 之前自定义其自动配置的 Hibernate 属性的 Bean 实现的回调接口。

items.source: Settings to apply when configuring Hibernate.
items.translation: 配置 Hibernate 时应用的设置。
